source: Support options in Abu Dhabi by stepped-care level (challenge brief). Kinds of support, not named providers: a pilot site adds its real services in content/directory/services.json. Cost notes are general; the psychiatrist and the licensed provider approve the final text.

options.title: Self-help
options.forWho: When things are manageable and you'd like tools to use on your own.
options.handOff: No referral needed. Coping cards and guides are always here, and you can check in again any time.

options.title: Community and counselling
options.forWho: Mild to moderate low mood, worry or stress, when talking to someone would help.
options.cost: Varies. Some community services are low cost or free; check whether your insurance plan covers counselling.
options.handOff: Your clinician suggests a service. With your agreement they refer you, and the service contacts you.

options.title: Primary care (your family doctor)
options.forWho: When physical health, medicines or sleep are part of the picture, or you'd like your family doctor involved.
options.cost: Usually covered by health insurance in Abu Dhabi. Check your plan for any co-payment.
options.handOff: With your consent, your clinician gives you a summary for your family doctor. Sending it directly through Malaffi is on the roadmap.

options.title: Tele-mental health
options.forWho: When you'd prefer video or phone sessions, or can't easily travel.
options.cost: Check your insurance plan. Some plans cover video sessions with licensed providers.
options.handOff: Your clinician refers you. The provider contacts you to book a first session.

options.title: Specialist mental health care (psychiatrist)
options.forWho: More severe or long-lasting difficulties, or when other support hasn't helped.
options.cost: Usually covered by health insurance, sometimes with a referral. Check your plan.
options.handOff: Your clinician makes the referral and tells you what to expect. You'll see each step on your timeline.

options.title: 800-SAKINA, 24/7 support line
options.forWho: Anyone who wants to talk to someone right now.
options.handOff: Call 800 725462 any time. No referral needed.
